role: candidate; the 18-industry flat version is the control

selection.note: industry selection stays at L2 because the deltaC concentration semantics are calibrated there

execution.rule: if the selected industry is 801081 (semis) or 801102 (communications), replace it with the L3 child whose deltaC is highest at that month-end; otherwise keep the L2
execution.etf_selection: 250d correlation vs the chosen index >= 0.80, top 8, then rank by 0.5*beta_rank + 0.5*HA77_composite_rank

timing: unchanged: deltaAR(1.5) hysteresis x TIP 21/63/126/252 calendar gate, next-day effect, residual in H11006

boundary.finding: extending L3 execution to battery (801737) and PV (801735) is negative: full Sharpe 1.727 -> 1.607, 2019-2023 1.304 -> 1.122, 2024-2026 unchanged
boundary.mechanism: semis and communications have genuinely diverging sub-sector cycles (equipment vs materials vs design); battery and PV sub-sectors move together, so ranking them by deltaC picks noise
boundary.rule: only enable L3 execution for L2s whose children show real dispersion; do not apply mechanically to all industries

known_limitations: all results are on inspected history; not independent OOS
small L3 industries (封测 14, 线缆 13, 加工设备 12) have noisy deltaC
ETF execution depends on the frozen HA composite (stale after 2026-06-30)
next: forward shadow tracking from 2026-11 alongside the 18-industry flat control; no further pool expansion
